title: About the Authors
text: ABOUT THE AU THORS CARLOS RUIZ ZAF ÓN , author of The Shadow of the Wind and The Angel’s Game , among other novels, is one of the world’s most read and best-loved writers. His work has been translated into more than forty languages and published around the world, garnering numerous international prizes and reaching millions of readers. He divides his time between Barcelona and Los Angeles. LUCIA GRAVES is the author and translator of many works and has overseen Spanish-language editions of the poetry of her father, Robert Graves.
